text_block_list.text:
Having poured their hearts into the 
knowledge of the Three Goddesses, the 
trainers and Umamusume went on to show 
tremendous growth—

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Oryaaaaaa~~h!!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
That's it, Bitter Glasse! Give it 
everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Hang in there, Little Cocon! Believe in 
your own weapons!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaa~~~~h!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Meek, it's a bit tough, but hang in there! 
This is where you have to dig deep!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Mmmmmmー!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I can barely keep up with Meek's growth 
myself. Every day is such a whirlwind of 
joy and busyness.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Still, I feel like I've grown leaps and 
bounds as Meek's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Not to say it's just because we've both 
grown, but next we're taking on a Graded 
race! Depending on the results, maybe even 
a bigger stage!"

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to you, things have been looking 
up on our end as well."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I feel like it's been a long time since 
I've seen those two run with such sparkle 
in their eyes.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Far from just returning to her old running 
style, Bitter Glace continues to exceed 
expectations, and Little Cocon's own 
weapons have grown even sharper.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon's in great shape. She's honed 
her strengths even more than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
That must be because my knowledge was 
combined with your passion.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Fufu... That might be so.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Then you've got to polish your weapons 
even more. For instance, there was once an 
Umamusume who honed her weapons like this—

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
That Umamusume, you know, she wasn't 
strong at first. She was left way behind 
in her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
“Yet, her eyes sparkled. She could feel 
herself getting fired up simply by running 
alongside her rivals.”

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Her Trainer respected her passion and 
entered her into races all over the place. 
In the Junior class alone, she ran 22 
races and won 15.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Racing against diverse opponents will 
polish her skills. She'll clash fiercely 
with the strongest Junior Umamusume and 
her Classic rivals—

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Before long, a match race against an 
American Triple Crown Umamusume took 
place, ending in victory after a fierce 
battle.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
There are many ways to hone a weapon. If 
you want to answer her enthusiasm, why not 
consider an option like this?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon doesn't like training with 
others, so I was subconsciously avoiding 
it, but... when I talked to her, she said 
she'd love to.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
They decided to take on the challenge 
because they have faith in you, Trainer 
Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: If that is the case, I am honored.

"The Three Goddesses, who support 
Umamusume and Trainers through vast 
amounts of data."

"That knowledge is so overwhelming that 
Trainers could easily become nothing more 
than mere messengers of information."

However, through the history that served 
as the foundation of their knowledge, the 
Three Goddesses also taught us the 
importance of the bond between an 
Umamusume and her Trainer.
choice_data_list: Let us continue to cherish our bond.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes, not just conveying knowledge, but 
putting your true feelings into it as 
well.
(Strum ♪)

Just then, an email arrived from the 
simulator.
(Strum ♪)

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Me as well...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...Bitter Glace and Little Cocon have 
received invitations."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...I guess it's still too early for Meek.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I'm in really great shape, so next 
year, for sure—”
(Strum ♪)

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? W-Wait a second...!?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"'Provisional Entry Registration—Pending 
results through the end of the year, entry 
into the SWBC shall be permitted'... 
...What?!"
choice_data_list: Let's all do our best for the SWBC!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

And so, with the "SWBC" just a few months 
away, the Trainers found themselves all 
the more fired up.
